why: CLAUDE.md: the whole Gita course carries needsReview and does not publish. A person who reads Sanskrit signs this off — the text against a printed edition, the three held readings (resolutions.json), the English attributions, and a listen to the chanting — and writes their name here. Until then the module opens only in tester mode.
owner_decisions: 3 Oct 2026: all 700 verses chanted by a computer voice, LABELLED as one on screen, until a human reciter records them; a reciter's file replaces each verse automatically.
3 Oct 2026: chant over situational music; reuse the Mahabharata paintings for the visuals.
